$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit converter family — NodeIR. Major version 1. Materialized at the Structural Mapping gate (issue #14 G2; ADR-005-013). Platform-neutral semantic tree of one approved design-source subtree: structure + layout primitives + content slots, zero target-platform vocabulary. Nodes are keyed by stable revision-independent hashed ids (locator-derived); the tree is expressed via childrenNodeIds in source document order; every node carries at least one design:// evidence locator at the pinned source revision. Layout is preserved verbatim from the source adapter's normalized primitives — no auto-layout guessing: unsupported values stay 'unknown', never inferred.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — NodeIR (design-source semantic tree)

profileId.description: Project profile the extraction ran under.

source.description: Design-source revision the tree was extracted from. Every node evidence carries the same revisionId — mixing revisions in one run is an EVIDENCE_MISSING-class failure.

rootNodeId.description: The inventoried subtree root (the caller-selected design node). Its parentNodeId is null.

nodes.description: Every descendant of the selected root, the root included — hidden layers, component instances, decorations and unknown nodes included; nothing silently omitted. Sorted by nodeId.

diagnostics.description: Extraction findings in canonical diagnostic order. Absolute/unknown constructs are reported here — never silently dropped.

nodeId.description: Stable identity: 'n-' + first 12 lowercase hex of SHA-256 over sourceId, designLocator and kind joined by U+241F. Locator-keyed — stable across source revisions (revision is tracked at payload level, not in the id). A 12-hex collision is a hard NODE_ID_COLLISION error.

kind.description: Closed enum. Adapter-defined source kinds are mapped by a documented deterministic table; unmappable source kinds stay 'unknown' (plus a NOT_VERIFIED warning), never guessed into a near-miss bucket. 'icon' is the vector/shape visual-primitive bucket; decoration semantics live in the review classification, not here.

name.description: Source layer label verbatim. A naming hint (e.g. a kind/role prefix convention) is evidence, never proof on its own.

role.description: Optional semantic role carried from evidence; open vocabulary. Name prefixes are hints only.

visible.description: Source visibility at the pinned revision. Hidden nodes stay inventoried here but are excluded from the PageStructure plan with an explicit reason in the review report.

childrenNodeIds.description: Child node ids in source document order. Document order is semantic, not arbitrary.

parentNodeId.description: null only for the root node. Parent/children declaration agreement is a semantic check.

componentRefNodeId.description: For instances: the inventoried shared component definition this node references (nodeId of a kind 'component' node). Absent when the reference targets a definition outside the extracted scope — that case is REFERENCE_ONLY in the review report, never fabricated.

contentSlots.description: Sorted by slotId. Absent when the node declares no content slots.

sourceEvidence.description: At least one design://<sourceId>/<locator> locator read at the pinned revision.

direction.description: Preserved from the source's normalized layout primitive; 'unknown' when the source does not declare it.

constraints.description: Sorted by axis (ties by type, then value).

target.description: Adapter-defined target reference (e.g. a child locator) — open vocabulary, not a nodeId.

slotId.description: kebab-case, derived from the source label; deduplicated deterministically.

valueRef.description: Scheme-whitelisted reference to the value's source location (typically design://<sourceId>/<locator>). Raw design content is not copied into the IR.

method.description: Provenance method reuse from the V1 classes (observed | derived | illustrative); open vocabulary, never a new class system.
